note: SRA on a 150-acre lake about 8 mi east and 2 mi south of Beatrice. 30 camping pads with electric, 2 non-electric pads and 40 non-pad basic sites; the main loop is on the peninsula on the lake's east side. Nearest dump station at Rock Creek Station SRA. Swim beach, one boat ramp/dock. --Claude
